scripts.server: cd src/backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix src/frontend install && npm --prefix plugins/warehouse install && npm --prefix plugins/box-size install && npm --prefix plugins/ai-description install && npm --prefix plugins/events install
scripts.dev:all: npm --prefix src/frontend run build:sdk && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,warehouse,box-size,ai-desc,events -c blue,yellow,magenta,cyan,green "npm --prefix src/frontend run dev" "npm --prefix plugins/warehouse run dev" "npm --prefix plugins/box-size run dev" "npm --prefix plugins/ai-description run dev" "npm --prefix plugins/events run dev"
